s.note: a DC classic after the morning run
s.how: Simmer 300g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 200g crushed tomatoes and 125ml water for 25 minutes. Split 4 smoked half-pork, half-beef sausages and grill 6 minutes. Serve in 4 buns with the chilli, yellow mustard and chopped onion.

s.note: the Captain America exhibit at the Smithsonian
s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 8 small patties and fry for 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar at the end. Fill slider buns with the patties and a pickle. Cut little stars from red capsicum with a small cutter and pin one on top of each with a toothpick.

m.note: Thai food written on Steve's list of things he missed
m.how: Stir-fry 600g minced or chopped chicken thighs with crushed garlic and chopped red chilli in a hot wok. Add a splash of fish sauce and a pinch of sugar, then toss through Thai basil. Serve over jasmine rice with a crisp fried egg on top.

w.how: Toss 400g frozen cherries and 200g blueberries with 100g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes until bubbling. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 1L cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain. Pour over ice in tall glasses, add cold milk and a spoon of vanilla syrup. Strong, cold and quiet.
